correctness.rationale: The normalized point Gram matrix is (2l+1) times exact rational Legendre kernel values on four computed dot classes. Invariant edge-array decomposition has dimensions 1+2+3+6 and gives all eigenvalues through three scalars and a two-by-two matrix. Direct exact rational elimination agrees with low-degree ranks, and recurrence verifies strict positivity of each sector for every l=7,...,575. A self-contained Laplace integral and pi<22/7 give strict diagonal dominance for every l>=576. The l=6 nullspace is exactly the antisymmetric divergence-free edge flow, whose annihilator is characterized by the three independent triangle-cycle constraints. The attached checker was run from the actual included source path and passed; it is a finite proof component rather than an extrapolation. Rank normalizations, quantifiers, zero cases and minimum-norm formula are explicit.

value.rationale: The twelve nodes form the canonical Archimedean tetrahedral truncation, rather than an arbitrary unmotivated selection. Degree six has a three-dimensional antisymmetric tetrahedral cycle-flow obstruction despite a thirteen-dimensional harmonic source, causing a nonmonotone rank reversal after degree five. This precise structural constraint and the sharp permanent full interpolation threshold of degree seven are natural stability/aliasing questions on a symmetric sampling geometry. It is a complete classification for all degrees with a reproducible finite certificate and analytic tail, not a minor numerical improvement or generic dimension count.
